description: Curated composition/camera variants. A hobby explicitly selects one where needed; otherwise the compiler deterministically assigns a variant within the hobby archetype. This prevents 3000+ cards from collapsing into one repeated composition per archetype.

solo_action.composition: One hero athlete dominates the frame at the decisive instant of action, with the body and equipment forming a strong diagonal.
solo_action.lighting: Directional arena or natural edge light that separates the athlete cleanly from the background.

solo_action.composition: Track the subject laterally in a clear side-on movement moment; background depth supports speed without competing with the hero.
solo_action.camera: Side-tracking medium shot with the subject crossing the frame.
solo_action.lighting: Clean directional light with restrained motion blur in the environment only.

solo_action.composition: The athlete advances toward or across the camera plane, making the key equipment a secondary foreground anchor.
solo_action.lighting: High-contrast hero lighting with clear face/body readability.

vertical_adventure.composition: The climber and climbing surface fill most of the frame; body tension and contact points are immediately readable.
vertical_adventure.lighting: Raking light across the wall/rock texture with clear subject separation.

vertical_adventure.composition: Freeze the instant before a difficult next hold, with one arm extending into clean negative space.
vertical_adventure.camera: Slightly low upward angle, close enough to read hands and feet.
vertical_adventure.lighting: Directional light emphasizing chalk, texture, and muscle tension.

vertical_adventure.composition: Show the final top-out or mantle moment, preserving the landing zone or route context below.
vertical_adventure.camera: Three-quarter angle near the top edge of the problem.
vertical_adventure.lighting: Warm achievement-oriented edge light without turning the scene into a distant landscape.

group_play.composition: Faces, hands, and the central game surface share the frame; capture a real reaction to a move.
group_play.camera: Intimate eye-level or slightly elevated medium shot.
group_play.lighting: Warm practical lamp light centered around the group.

group_play.composition: The game board is the visual center, with multiple hands entering naturally from around the table and faces visible at the edge of frame.
group_play.camera: High three-quarter tabletop angle, not a flat diagram.
group_play.lighting: Warm pooled table light with darker surrounding room.

group_play.composition: Look past one player toward the board and other reacting players, creating depth and participation.
group_play.lighting: Soft social interior light with one warm focal source.

food_hero.composition: The hero dish fills the lower-middle frame while one human hand completes, serves, or reaches toward it.
food_hero.lighting: Premium warm food light with appetising highlights and controlled background bokeh.

food_hero.composition: The dish is presented at the moment of handoff from maker to diner, with the food still dominating the image.
food_hero.lighting: Warm restaurant key light with subtle steam/specular detail.

food_hero.composition: One hero plate anchors an intimate dining moment; surrounding context is minimal and subordinate.
food_hero.lighting: Soft lantern/candle-like ambience with crisp food texture.

drink_ritual.composition: Hands and the signature drink form one intimate focal cluster; café or home context falls softly behind.
drink_ritual.lighting: Soft window or café light with warm highlights.

drink_ritual.composition: Capture the decisive preparation/pour moment so the ritual itself is visible, not merely the finished drink.
drink_ritual.camera: Three-quarter close-up on hands, vessel, and cup.
drink_ritual.lighting: Warm tactile light with visible steam/liquid detail.

drink_ritual.composition: Two people share a quiet beverage moment, but one signature drink remains the primary visual anchor.
drink_ritual.lighting: Warm social light with uncluttered background.

travel_vista.composition: A road, path, rail line, river edge, trail, or transit form leads the eye from a traveler or vehicle into a distinctive non-textual destination. Keep road signs, storefront text, station boards, ads, and license plates out of view.
travel_vista.camera: Wide three-quarter view with strong leading lines and no signboard as focal point.
travel_vista.lighting: Destination-specific golden/blue-hour light without stock-photo lens flare.

travel_vista.composition: A traveler fills the near foreground while non-textual architecture, terrain, skyline, shoreline, or transit form identifies the destination behind. Crop away readable signs, shopfront lettering, posters, and road boards.
travel_vista.camera: Medium-wide rear or three-quarter traveler perspective.
travel_vista.lighting: Cinematic natural light with layered depth.

travel_vista.composition: Use a doorway, alley opening, ridge, bridge, natural frame, or architectural opening to reveal the destination through shape and place character rather than signage or text.
travel_vista.lighting: Controlled contrast between foreground frame and luminous destination.

urban_discovery.composition: A person actively discovers something at a lively but readable street corner, with one specific hobby action as the anchor.
urban_discovery.lighting: Mixed storefront and ambient city light.

urban_discovery.composition: Look over the participant's shoulder toward the object/place they have just discovered.
urban_discovery.lighting: Natural or practical light emphasizing discovery.

urban_discovery.composition: Frame the hobby through an inviting storefront/window/stall interaction rather than a generic skyline.

performance.composition: Performer and instrument/action dominate the frame, with enough venue atmosphere to convey performance.
performance.lighting: Focused key light with restrained background bokeh.

performance.composition: Hands and the expressive interaction with the instrument/action become the foreground anchor while the performer remains identifiable.
View the performer past a small amount of audience foreground to emphasize a shared live experience.
performance.lighting: Stage light focused on the performer, audience subdued.

creative_studio.composition: Hands, tools, and material dominate the scene at the most tactile step of creation.
creative_studio.lighting: Warm directional studio/window light revealing material texture.

creative_studio.composition: Show the maker's focused expression together with the active work surface; neither may obscure the making process.
creative_studio.lighting: Soft studio key light with warm work-surface highlights.

creative_studio.composition: Use tools/materials as diagonal leading elements toward the active making point.
creative_studio.lighting: Practical studio light with controlled depth.

lens_perspective.composition: The observer/photographer occupies much of the foreground; their camera/lens action is primary and the viewed scene is secondary.
lens_perspective.lighting: Natural directional light with crisp equipment detail.

lens_perspective.composition: Show a strong profile of the person actively looking through the viewfinder/lens at the exact capture moment.
A large lens or viewing tool anchors the foreground while the person and target scene remain understandable behind it.
lens_perspective.camera: Close-medium perspective with foreground equipment emphasis.
lens_perspective.lighting: Controlled highlight on glass/equipment without fake flare.

tech_workspace.composition: Look over the creator's shoulder toward a physical technology setup: hands manipulate a prototype, model, sensor, robot, device, camera, or material object while a real physical result or indicator-light response is visible. Do not show a readable display surface; any monitor must be back-facing, edge-on, dark, or out of frame.
tech_workspace.camera: Over-shoulder medium shot centered on hands, physical input, prototype, and real-world response rather than a display.
tech_workspace.lighting: Controlled modern light with crisp hands/hardware detail; no screen glow as the primary light source.

tech_workspace.composition: The person actively manipulates hardware, controls, a prototype, stylus-on-blank-surface, camera, sensor, device, robot, circuit, or other concrete technology input. Use physical indicators, movement, materials, lights, or mechanical response instead of a visible interface. No front-facing screen.
tech_workspace.camera: Three-quarter medium workstation or maker-bench view emphasizing hands, physical tools, and the object being changed.
tech_workspace.lighting: Controlled modern light with a clear face/hands/tool focal hierarchy and minimal display glow.

tech_workspace.composition: Connect a physical object, device, component, gesture, sample, or prototype to a visible real-world response such as movement, indicator lights, projected light without text, changed material state, or a second physical object. Keep monitor/display faces out of view.
tech_workspace.camera: Medium-wide diagonal workstation or lab view with clear physical cause-and-effect and no front-facing display.
tech_workspace.lighting: Modern cool base with restrained luminous accents and strong material detail.

collection_object_hero.composition: Hands actively build or arrange one clearly readable collectible/object system; a single hero element sits in sharp foreground focus.
collection_object_hero.lighting: Bright premium tabletop light with tactile detail.

collection_object_hero.composition: A curated hero object dominates the foreground with a small amount of collection context behind it.
collection_object_hero.lighting: Museum-like or warm collector lighting, not sterile catalogue light.

collection_object_hero.composition: Use one unmistakable construction/material detail as a large foreground recognition anchor while the broader hobby context remains visible.
collection_object_hero.lighting: Crisp detail lighting with controlled depth of field.

calm_wellness.composition: One calm human ritual sits centrally with generous uncluttered space around it.
Use side window light to frame a quiet wellness action in profile.
calm_wellness.lighting: Gentle window light with low contrast.

calm_wellness.composition: Hands and the specific self-care/wellness action become the tactile foreground anchor.

nature_immersion.composition: A warm activity anchor such as fire, tent, fishing setup, or telescope dominates the foreground/midground while nature supports it.
nature_immersion.lighting: Strong warm/cool contrast between activity light and environment.

nature_immersion.composition: A person is visibly engaged in the nature activity while a path, shoreline, or terrain leads into the setting.
nature_immersion.lighting: Natural dawn/dusk light without generic postcard treatment.

nature_immersion.composition: Specific hobby gear is unmistakable in the foreground while the natural setting creates scale behind it.
nature_immersion.camera: Low or seated perspective with layered depth.
nature_immersion.lighting: Natural atmospheric light with crisp gear detail.

story_culture.composition: The audience/participant is visible from behind or three-quarter view while the cultural medium itself dominates the focal area.
story_culture.camera: Centered or slightly off-center medium-wide audience perspective.
story_culture.lighting: Venue light spilling from the medium onto the audience.

story_culture.composition: Show a person actively reading, viewing, performing, or engaging with the cultural medium rather than posing beside it.
Reveal the cultural venue and medium together so the setting supports, rather than replaces, the actual experience.
story_culture.lighting: Dramatic venue light with a clear focal source.

learning_exploration.composition: Hands and one concrete object, specimen, source, map-like non-text visual, or instrument anchor the act of discovery while the learner remains visibly engaged.
learning_exploration.lighting: Clean directional window or field light with crisp object detail.

learning_exploration.composition: Two people discuss or compare one physical source, object, specimen, model, or place cue that makes the subject visually specific.
learning_exploration.lighting: Warm collaborative light with the subject anchor brighter than the background.

learning_exploration.composition: A learner actively observes or documents a real-world subject in its natural, historical, museum, workshop, or scientific context.
learning_exploration.camera: Rear or side three-quarter environmental medium-wide view.
learning_exploration.lighting: Natural contextual light with strong subject separation.

companion_bond.composition: Human and animal share one natural interaction at eye level; the animal remains large enough to identify immediately.
companion_bond.lighting: Soft natural light with expressive face and fur/feather/scale detail.

companion_bond.composition: Hands perform one clear species-appropriate care, grooming, training, habitat, or enrichment action.
companion_bond.lighting: Clean warm practical light with crisp action detail.

companion_bond.composition: The animal is shown with one unmistakable habitat, equipment, or observation cue while a person engages from a safe natural distance.
companion_bond.lighting: Natural habitat light with the animal as the clear focal point.

companion_bond.composition: Human and animal are caught in one clear training or agility action; the obstacle, cue, movement, and safe handler position make the activity unmistakable.
companion_bond.camera: Dynamic eye-level or slightly low medium-wide action view.
companion_bond.lighting: Clean natural or training-venue light with crisp animal motion and obstacle/cue detail.

professional_world.composition: Frame one professional performing a concrete field-specific task with a large physical tool, object, client, specimen, instrument, product, or work surface. The task itself must dominate; any screen or paper is secondary, blank, and unreadable.
professional_world.camera: Three-quarter medium or medium-close action shot centered on hands, tool, object, and task.
professional_world.lighting: Polished workplace light with cinematic subject separation and no glowing-screen dominance.

professional_world.composition: Two or three people actively collaborate around one tangible work object, prototype, sample, model, equipment setup, client interaction, or physical case material. Faces, hands, and the shared object carry the story; no presentation slide is needed.
professional_world.camera: Eye-level collaborative medium shot with the tangible work anchor large in frame.
professional_world.lighting: Warm focused team light with a quiet, non-textual background.

professional_world.composition: Place the professional inside a recognisable workplace while they perform one specific physical task. Use equipment, architecture, client interaction, or work materials to identify the role; keep signage, screens, certificates, posters, newspapers, and paperwork out of focal view.
professional_world.camera: Human-height medium-wide environmental frame with the person and physical task clearly dominant.
professional_world.lighting: Naturalistic workplace light enhanced with premium illustration contrast.

journey_machine.composition: One generic unbranded machine or vehicle moves through a strong route or terrain line, with enough environmental context to explain the enthusiast activity.
journey_machine.lighting: Directional outdoor light with clean machine silhouette and motion depth.

journey_machine.composition: Hands actively maintain, build, tune, or inspect one machine component while the larger generic vehicle remains readable nearby.
journey_machine.lighting: Warm workshop key light with crisp mechanical texture.

journey_machine.composition: A person interacts with one unbranded vehicle or machine before, during, or after a journey; posture and setting show enthusiasm rather than sales.
journey_machine.lighting: Cinematic natural or garage light without glossy advertisement treatment.

music_listening.composition: One listener is absorbed in music through plain unbranded headphones; expression and body language sell the emotional experience while the environment stays supportive.
music_listening.camera: Intimate three-quarter medium-close portrait in action.
music_listening.lighting: Soft cinematic practical light with warm skin tones and restrained cool ambient depth.

music_listening.composition: Hands select or place an unbranded record while a small curated shelf/turntable context shows active music discovery without readable covers.
music_listening.lighting: Warm shelf or room light with crisp hand, sleeve, and turntable detail.

music_listening.composition: Two people share a listening moment around speakers or one music source, reacting naturally rather than posing.
music_listening.lighting: Warm domestic or studio practical light with one soft focal pool.

music_listening.composition: A listener actively chooses, adjusts, or reacts to music in a coherent room setup with generic speakers or audio gear large enough to read.
music_listening.lighting: Low-key evening ambience with warm practical highlights on person and audio gear.

music_listening.composition: A listener is visibly immersed in a small generic live-music environment; performer silhouettes or instruments support the experience without becoming a named artist depiction.
music_listening.camera: Audience-level medium-wide with listener and stage context both readable.
music_listening.lighting: Controlled live-venue light with no logos, banners, or readable signage.

reading_world.composition: One reader and one plain open book form the focal cluster; posture and expression show absorption while the pages remain blank, softly patterned, or completely unreadable.
reading_world.camera: Close-medium seated three-quarter view that crops away signage and distant shelf labels.
reading_world.lighting: Warm window or lamp light with crisp book and hand detail.

reading_world.composition: A reader pulls or compares one or two plain books from a shelf. Keep shelf spines abstract and non-readable and crop away section signs or labels.
reading_world.camera: Human-height medium environmental frame centered on hands, book, and reader reaction.
reading_world.lighting: Soft library daylight or warm aisle light with clean depth.

reading_world.composition: Two or three people discuss plain unbranded books around one shared table or seating area; faces, gestures, and blank-cover books carry the story.
A person compares or opens one or two plain books at a simple display with no visible shop sign, price tag, shelf label, poster, or readable cover text.
reading_world.camera: Three-quarter medium view cropped tightly around reader, hands, and books.
reading_world.lighting: Inviting retail ambient light with the reader as focal subject.

reading_world.composition: A reader is immersed in one plain book in a calm park, garden, or outdoor seating area; the book and reading act stay larger than the scenery and no café signage is visible.
reading_world.lighting: Gentle natural daylight with soft atmospheric separation.

strategy_table.composition: The strategy surface is central while one or more hands make a decisive move and faces remain partly visible.
strategy_table.camera: High three-quarter tabletop view, not a flat diagram.
strategy_table.lighting: Warm focused table light with crisp piece/card/tile separation.

strategy_table.composition: A focused player reaction and the board/card/tile state share the frame so thought and play are both readable.
strategy_table.camera: Eye-level three-quarter medium shot across the play surface.
strategy_table.lighting: Soft social interior light with the play surface slightly brighter.

strategy_table.composition: Two players face each other across one strategy surface at a clear decision moment.
strategy_table.lighting: Controlled warm light with clean hands, pieces, and faces.

digital_play.composition: Look past the player toward the back/edge of a generic display while controller/keyboard/handheld input and the player's reaction remain clearly visible. Do not reveal gameplay UI.
digital_play.camera: Tight rear-three-quarter medium shot that hides the display face.
digital_play.lighting: Warm room light with only restrained, defocused ambient device glow.

digital_play.composition: Two players react naturally while using generic unbranded controllers. The television or monitor is seen only from the back/edge or kept out of frame; controllers and reactions carry the play story.
digital_play.camera: Three-quarter social medium shot from beside/behind the display.
digital_play.lighting: Warm living-room light with restrained ambient device glow.

digital_play.composition: Hands on keyboard/mouse or simulator controls and the player's focused reaction form one clear play story. Keep the monitor face out of frame or turned away from the viewer.
digital_play.camera: Side three-quarter workstation medium shot that excludes the display face.
digital_play.lighting: Clean practical room light with no readable monitor content.

digital_play.composition: A player physically interacts with one generic arcade or claw-style machine; hands, controls, and machine mechanism remain readable without logos.
digital_play.lighting: Colorful venue light kept controlled enough to preserve machine/action clarity.

fitness_training.composition: Freeze the strongest readable phase of one exercise repetition with correct posture and relevant equipment.
fitness_training.lighting: Directional gym/studio light defining body mechanics without glamour-ad treatment.

fitness_training.composition: Show the exercise side-on so joint position, movement path, and equipment are easy to read.
fitness_training.lighting: Clean natural or studio training light.

fitness_training.composition: Frame the exercise so body mechanics and the relevant mat, machine, weight, bike, rope, or studio equipment are easy to read without forcing every activity into a floor pose.
fitness_training.camera: Human-height or slightly elevated medium-wide technique view.
fitness_training.lighting: Soft but crisp training light with uncluttered background.

water_outdoors.composition: Capture the defining active instant on or in the water, keeping body position and activity-specific gear unmistakable.
water_outdoors.camera: Water-level or close shoreline three-quarter action view.
water_outdoors.lighting: Natural directional light with crisp water/gear separation.

water_outdoors.composition: The person and relevant board/boat/kayak/canoe or other vessel form the central action cluster with route/water context behind.
water_outdoors.camera: Side or rear three-quarter medium-wide view.
water_outdoors.lighting: Natural outdoor light with readable vessel shape and water texture.

water_outdoors.composition: For slower water hobbies, show hands, line, mask, observation gear, catch, or preparation interacting directly with the water activity.
water_outdoors.lighting: Natural dawn/daylight with strong gear and hand detail.

outdoor_motion.composition: Track the participant laterally through the correct terrain or surface while equipment and body position remain clear.
outdoor_motion.lighting: Natural directional outdoor light with controlled motion depth.

outdoor_motion.composition: The route or terrain leads the eye through one decisive movement moment; person and gear remain large enough to identify.
outdoor_motion.lighting: Cinematic natural light without postcard treatment.

outdoor_motion.composition: Bring the athlete and terrain interaction close enough to show wheel, ski, board, shoe, or other contact mechanics.
outdoor_motion.camera: Low or human-height close-medium action angle.
outdoor_motion.lighting: Crisp edge light and textured terrain detail.

home_lifestyle.composition: Hands actively improve, arrange, repair, organize, plant, or make something in a lived-in home space.
home_lifestyle.lighting: Warm natural window light with tactile object/tool detail.

home_lifestyle.composition: One or two people perform the defining home or family activity while the room context stays specific and believable.
Bring the defining home object, plant, tool, furniture detail, storage system, or care task into the foreground while the person actively tends, adjusts, organizes, or improves it.
home_lifestyle.lighting: Warm natural light with crisp hand, object, material, or plant detail.

food_exploration.composition: Show the moment a person receives, chooses, or tastes a dish at close range. Frame inward toward food, hands, steam, counter, and reaction; exclude storefront signs, banners, menu boards, branded décor, and readable wall text.
food_exploration.camera: Human-height three-quarter medium or medium-close view.
food_exploration.lighting: Warm experiential light with appetising food highlights and quiet background surfaces.

food_exploration.composition: Two or three people actively share, compare, or discover a meal at one table; dishes, hands, tea, serving action, and reactions fill the frame while walls and venue signage remain absent or blank.
food_exploration.lighting: Warm social dining light with crisp hero dishes.

food_exploration.composition: Capture receiving, tasting, or comparing food at a plain unbranded counter or serving surface. Keep the frame tight on food, hands, utensils, and reaction; no menus, labels, signs, or branding.
food_exploration.lighting: Premium warm practical light with clean human/food separation.

campus_activity.composition: A small student group actively participates in the defining campus activity with one concrete non-text cue carrying the identity.
campus_activity.lighting: Bright natural or campus practical light with clean participant/activity separation.

campus_activity.composition: Students actively debate, advocate, or present across a formal generic room layout; opposing sides, speaker posture, and attentive peers make the event readable without logos or text.
campus_activity.camera: Human-height medium-wide from audience or side aisle.
campus_activity.lighting: Clean institutional light with strong speaker emphasis.

campus_activity.composition: Students actively produce campus media using a microphone, camera, audio desk, editing station, or publication workflow; equipment and collaboration are unmistakable.
campus_activity.lighting: Warm practical media-room light with crisp equipment detail.

campus_activity.composition: Students actively solve, build, calculate, present, or compare work in a competition setting with generic physical materials and visible concentration.
campus_activity.lighting: Clean event light with focused work surfaces and reactions.

campus_activity.composition: Students from different backgrounds actively explore or connect in a campus/exchange setting through conversation, orientation, shared activity, or arrival context.
campus_activity.lighting: Natural optimistic daylight with clear people/place separation.

campus_activity.composition: Students actively organize, volunteer, or participate in one campus club/event activity with tables, materials, badges-without-text, or hands-on action supporting the scene.
campus_activity.lighting: Bright social event lighting with uncluttered context.

community_gathering.composition: A small group leans into an engaged conversation around one shared topic or object; reactions feel natural and specific.
People actively make, repair, compare, teach, or explore one shared activity together rather than merely standing and talking.
community_gathering.lighting: Warm focused activity light with readable hands/objects.

community_gathering.composition: Several people form a natural conversational cluster in a meetup/event setting, with one profession/hobby cue and no corporate handshake posing.
Two or more people actively exchange, compare, or browse tangible items across a table or community stall.
community_gathering.camera: Slightly elevated medium view keeping people and exchange objects visible.
community_gathering.lighting: Warm community-market light with crisp object detail.

wellness_experience.composition: A person actively experiences a clear non-medical wellness venue or ritual; the environment and body interaction identify the experience.
wellness_experience.lighting: Soft atmospheric wellness light with clean environmental cues.

wellness_experience.composition: The person is visibly immersed in or entering a hot/cold water ritual, with pool/tub/spring context and safe body position unmistakable.
wellness_experience.camera: Medium experiential side or three-quarter view.
wellness_experience.lighting: Natural steam/cool-water atmosphere with clear human/environment separation.

wellness_experience.composition: The sauna/heat-room experience is unmistakable through wood/stone heat context, seated relaxed posture, and atmospheric warmth without branding.
A non-medical spa or massage-like wellness treatment is shown through safe professional hands, table/chair context, towels or generic treatment cues without products or logos.
A resting participant experiences a generic sound-based wellness session with bowls or instruments clearly visible, avoiding mystical text or symbols.
wellness_experience.lighting: Calm diffused light with instrument highlights.

creator_workflow.composition: A creator actively works with one medium-specific physical tool while a clean generic production workspace supports the action. Keep monitor faces absent, turned away, or out of frame.
creator_workflow.camera: Three-quarter medium workstation view centered on hands and the physical production tool.
creator_workflow.lighting: Warm practical creator-studio light with no screen used as a dominant light source.

creator_workflow.composition: A creator actively records voice or sound with a plain microphone, headphones, and acoustic/audio context clearly visible.
creator_workflow.camera: Close-medium side or three-quarter recording view.
creator_workflow.lighting: Warm studio key light with crisp microphone and face detail.

creator_workflow.composition: A creator actively records or presents to a generic camera/phone rig with lighting, microphone, tripod, or framing gear visible. No monitor is visible in the background. The recording device is shown from the side/rear so its display face is hidden, dark, blank, or too oblique to carry UI.
creator_workflow.camera: Behind-camera or three-quarter medium view that shows the creator and physical rig while hiding all display faces.
creator_workflow.lighting: Clean creator lighting with warm human tones and a simple screen-free background.

creator_workflow.composition: Show an editor actively working through physical editing tools: headphones, a jog/shuttle wheel, control surface, keyboard, stylus, camera media, or storyboard/image cards. Any monitor is back-facing, edge-on, dark, or heavily defocused and must not display a timeline, waveform, toolbar, panels, labels, or UI.
creator_workflow.camera: Tight three-quarter medium view centered on hands, editing controls, headphones, media, and creator focus; monitor faces are excluded.
creator_workflow.lighting: Balanced room light with crisp physical-tool interaction and no readable screen glow.

creator_workflow.composition: The creator actively draws, animates, sequences, or refines visual media using a stylus and drawing surface. Prefer a paper-like or blank tablet surface viewed at a steep angle; if digital imagery is visible, it is only a large simple non-textual illustration fragment with no interface chrome.
creator_workflow.camera: Close-medium hands-and-stylus view with the drawing surface highly oblique and interface-free.
creator_workflow.lighting: Soft studio light with crisp stylus/hand/visual-work detail.

creator_workflow.composition: A creator actively drafts or edits written content using a notebook, index cards, keyboard, or writing tools. Keep all monitor/display faces out of frame or turned away; no visible article layout or text is needed.
creator_workflow.camera: Warm close-medium writing perspective centered on hands and physical writing tools.
creator_workflow.lighting: Natural window or desk-lamp light without screen glow.

creator_workflow.composition: A creator actively broadcasts gameplay or live content using a generic microphone, camera, controller/keyboard, headphones, and lighting rig. Show the back or edge of the monitor only; player reaction and physical broadcast equipment must communicate streaming without visible gameplay UI or chat.
creator_workflow.camera: Three-quarter medium creator-and-rig view from beside or behind the display, so no screen face is visible.
creator_workflow.lighting: Controlled studio light with warm human accents and no interface glow.

shared_workspace.composition: Arrange three to five adult professionals along one long communal desk or two adjacent shared desks. Each person has a distinct simple work setup; one pair may briefly exchange an idea while the others work independently. Keep the office furniture and shared-space layout obvious and keep all screens blank, turned away, abstract, or unreadable.
shared_workspace.camera: Eye-level medium-wide diagonal across the communal desks, showing multiple separate workstations and shared seating in one frame.
shared_workspace.lighting: Bright natural office daylight with warm practical accents and clean separation between people and desks.

shared_workspace.composition: Show adults working independently across a mix of shared tables and casual coworking seating with laptops, notebooks, headphones, mugs, plants, and one visible communal amenity. The scene must read as a flexible shared office, not a social event or workshop.
shared_workspace.camera: Human-height medium-wide environmental frame showing the shared-space layout.
shared_workspace.lighting: Soft daylight with polished lifestyle-office contrast.

campaign_planning.composition: Build the scene around one clean tabletop containing a generic unbranded product sample, two or three blank packaging mockups, several image cards, and unlabeled color/material swatches. Two or three adults point, compare, move, and refine these elements; no screens are needed.
campaign_planning.camera: Oblique overhead medium shot that keeps hands, product sample, blank mockups, image cards, and swatches simultaneously visible.
campaign_planning.lighting: Clean creative-studio daylight with crisp material detail and premium color separation.

campaign_planning.composition: Keep the primary action on a physical planning table while a few blank image/layout blocks sit on a nearby wall with no text. Adults actively compare product mockups and imagery; the wall remains secondary and purely visual.
campaign_planning.camera: Three-quarter medium-wide view anchored on the table and hands.
campaign_planning.lighting: Warm modern studio light with a bright, non-textual planning surface.

legal_practice.composition: An adult advocate in formal professional clothing stands or gestures beside a counsel table in a generic courtroom, oriented toward a judge bench or witness area. Use closed blank folders and neutral courtroom furniture only; no readable documents or signage.
legal_practice.camera: Eye-level medium-wide courtroom view with advocate, counsel table, and bench architecture all readable.
legal_practice.lighting: Controlled natural courtroom light with polished subject separation.

legal_practice.composition: An adult legal professional and adult client confer across a formal table with closed blank folders and a simple neutral office/court-adjacent setting. Body language shows advice and review without relying on visible document text.
legal_practice.lighting: Warm restrained office light with serious, trustworthy tone.

legal_practice.composition: Two or three adult students or young adults conduct a formal mock-trial or moot-court argument in a generic courtroom. One advocate stands and presents while teammates sit at a counsel table; a neutral judge or judging panel is visible. Use blank folders only and no readable case names, placards, certificates, or text.
legal_practice.camera: Eye-level medium-wide courtroom frame showing advocate, counsel table, and judge or judging panel.
legal_practice.lighting: Clean institutional courtroom light with warm professional subject separation.

aviation_world.composition: A generic unbranded full-size aircraft fills the main visual field in a hangar, apron, or airfield setting while one or two adults inspect, prepare, board, or admire it. The aircraft—not any ground vehicle—must dominate the frame.
aviation_world.camera: Three-quarter medium-wide view emphasizing wings, fuselage/cockpit, and landing gear with people for scale.
aviation_world.lighting: Clean natural or hangar light with strong aircraft silhouette and material detail.

aviation_world.composition: A pilot or aviation enthusiast performs a pre-flight or cockpit interaction with a generic unbranded aircraft; controls may be visible only as non-readable shapes and instruments, with no labels or registration text.
aviation_world.camera: Close-medium cockpit/doorway or wing-root perspective that keeps aircraft identity unmistakable.
aviation_world.lighting: Balanced cockpit and daylight illumination with crisp mechanical detail.
